meta.title: Budget becomes Approved and active only after all approvers approve
gaps: Approve a submitted budget as the first approver and verify it is not yet Approved.
Have the remaining approver or approvers approve and verify the budget becomes Approved and active for the specified department and categories.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Approve a submitted budget as the first approver and verify it is not yet Approved.; Have the remaining approver or approvers approve and verify the budget becomes Approved and active for the specified department and categories.

args.need: approve the submitted budget as the first approver, verify its status is not Approved, then have all remaining approvers approve and verify the budget status is Approved and active for the specified department and categories

steps.note: No catalog step can open a budget, perform approvals by multiple approvers, or inspect budget status and activation scope.
Confirm the final budget screen visibly shows the expected Approved status after the tester completes the workflow.
